SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2025-07' THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END) AS sales_pretax_2025_07,
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2025-08' THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END) AS sales_pretax_2025_08,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2025-08' THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2025-07' THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2025-07' THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sales_pretax_growth_pct
FROM jaffle_shop.dev.orders
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) IN ('2025-07', '2025-08')
